final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), stats AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members, AVG(member_count) AS average_count FROM group_counts) SELECT gc.link_to_major, gc.member_count, CAST(gc.member_count AS REAL) / s.total_members AS fraction_of_total, CAST(gc.member_count AS REAL) / s.average_count AS ratio_to_average FROM group_counts AS gc CROSS JOIN stats AS s ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
